The retriever is trained end-to-end with the generator, treating the retrieved document as a latent variable, and the paper proposes two variants, RAG-Sequence and RAG-Token, which marginalize over latent documents differently [629379b5-af6d-44b9-9109-0f13294fdab9]. Specifically, the authors build a single MIPS index using FAISS with a Hierarchical Navigable Small World approximation for fast retrieval [34dee075-dd72-4fd5-bbc0-62796d4060ad]. results.answer: RAG-Sequence uses the same retrieved document to generate the complete sequence; the retrieved document is treated as a single latent variable and marginalized over the top-K documents to get p(y|x) [629379b5-af6d-44b9-9109-0f13294fdab9] [f0041774-13fc-47ac-9099-a98f3fb65ea7]. RAG-Token can draw a different latent document for each target token and marginalize accordingly, so the generator can choose content from several documents when producing an answer [629379b5-af6d-44b9-9109-0f13294fdab9] [f0041774-13fc-47ac-9099-a98f3fb65ea7]. Formally, RAG-Token marginalizes over documents inside the product over output tokens, while RAG-Sequence marginalizes once over the whole sequence probability [f0041774-13fc-47ac-9099-a98f3fb65ea7]. The two are equivalent for sequence classification, where the target class is treated as a sequence of length one [f0041774-13fc-47ac-9099-a98f3fb65ea7]. In the paper's results, RAG-Sequence produced more diverse generations than RAG-Token [b5e84010-0aef-47b8-a71d-f3ca7d8cea4c], while RAG-Token performed better on Jeopardy question generation [c6da7a38-24ff-436b-af2c-892c764405a0].

results.answer: The passages do not say which decoding approach RAG-Sequence uses on Open-MSMarco or Jeopardy, and they do not give a reason for any such choice. They describe two decoding procedures. "Thorough Decoding" runs extra forward passes so that, for each document z where y does not appear in the beam, the generator probability is multiplied by p(z|x) and the probabilities are summed across beams for the marginals [204f950c-8aff-4c7d-99e4-73364e352301]. "Fast Decoding" approximates p(y|x,z_i) as roughly 0 for any y not generated during beam search, which avoids extra forward passes [204f950c-8aff-4c7d-99e4-73364e352301]. The passages note that Thorough Decoding can require many forward passes for longer outputs, which is the motivation for Fast Decoding [204f950c-8aff-4c7d-99e4-73364e352301]. results.answer: RAG uses a Dense Passage Retriever (DPR) as its retriever [c65cfecb-c3d8-4c8c-b7b7-dbc34d06923a]. Its architecture pairs a pre-trained seq2seq generator (BART) as parametric memory with a non-parametric memory consisting of a dense vector index of Wikipedia accessed by the retriever, combined in a probabilistic model trained end-to-end [c65cfecb-c3d8-4c8c-b7b7-dbc34d06923a]. The retriever provides latent documents conditioned on the input, and the generator conditions on these documents together with the input to produce the output; the latent documents are marginalized via a top-K approximation, either per output sequence (RAG-Sequence) or per token (RAG-Token) [c65cfecb-c3d8-4c8c-b7b7-dbc34d06923a][34dee075-dd72-4fd5-bbc0-62796d4060ad]. results.answer: RAG-Sequence uses the same retrieved document to generate the complete sequence; the retrieved document is treated as a single latent variable and marginalized over top-K documents, with probability computed per document and then summed [629379b5-af6d-44b9-9109-0f13294fdab9] [f0041774-13fc-47ac-9099-a98f3fb65ea7]. RAG-Token can draw a different latent document for each target token and marginalize accordingly, allowing the generator to choose content from several documents when producing an answer [629379b5-af6d-44b9-9109-0f13294fdab9]. Formally, RAG-Token takes the product over output positions of the sum over documents of the token probabilities, whereas RAG-Sequence sums over documents of the retriever probability times the product of token probabilities [f0041774-13fc-47ac-9099-a98f3fb65ea7]. For sequence classification, the two are equivalent because the target class is treated as a sequence of length one [f0041774-13fc-47ac-9099-a98f3fb65ea7]. In the paper's experiments, RAG-Sequence generations were more diverse than RAG-Token's [b5e84010-0aef-47b8-a71d-f3ca7d8cea4c], while RAG-Token performed better on Jeopardy question generation [096855fc-7145-4f12-b12c-a5c8d74038ac] [c6da7a38-24ff-436b-af2c-892c764405a0].
results.judge_reasoning: The system answer correctly states the core difference: RAG-Sequence uses the same retrieved document for the whole sequence, while RAG-Token allows a different document per token. results.answer: The passages do not say which decoding procedure RAG-Sequence uses on Open-MSMarco or Jeopardy. They describe two options.
